method: Standard double-out checkout search. Every dart is enumerated from the 20 singles, 20 trebles, 20 doubles, the outer bull (25) and the bull (50); the last dart must be a double or the bull. The shortest route wins, and ties are broken by preferring single or treble setup darts, then the highest-scoring first dart, then the highest-scoring second dart. The page also reports the score left after each dart and up to three alternative routes with the same dart count. Scores above 170 need more than three darts, 1 has no finish, and 159, 162, 163, 165, 166, 168 and 169 have no three-dart checkout. Double-in and straight-out games are not modelled.
